name: Prevent stale feature resurrection after cascade deletion
description: Regression hardening for feature deletion under concurrent or stale full-document writes. Current implementation: `packages/plan-core/src/feature-delete.ts` centralizes `deleteFeatureCascade`, acquires the batch writer lock, deletes or unlinks owned phases, writes generated views, and verifies that the feature is absent from a fresh read. `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` exposes full-document `saveFeatures`/`saveFeaturesRaw` paths used by maintenance and migration flows; a stale snapshot can currently reinsert a feature ID that `deleteFeatureCascade` already removed, while the phase remains deleted. Goals: preserve atomic deletion semantics across concurrent writers, prevent deleted feature IDs from being resurrected by stale snapshots, keep legitimate migration/creation flows working, and add focused regression coverage for the exact feature-present/phase-absent symptom. Preserve existing cascade and unlink behavior, canonical feature references, generated-output synchronization, and cross-harness callers.
